summary: LegalAI — affordable, easy-to-use, secure AI tool for solo and small-firm lawyers, offering automation of tasks such as document organization, motion responses, deposition summaries, citation verification, case law research, video transcription, timeline creation, and matter management, starting at $179/mo, HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2/ISO 27001 certified.
LegalAI Blog provides notes, analysis, and field reports on the intersection of legal practice and artificial intelligence, offering AI tools for solo and small firm lawyers to reclaim time.
